The following is a series of equations and R code functions used in the Geoderma Short Communication Manuscript.

## Bioturbation, Freeze-thaw, & Snow/rain compaction

$$\Delta \rho = \rho_{i} \cdot \frac{D_p}{D_p + \Delta z} - \rho_{i}$$

Where ∆ρ is the required change in bulk density, ρinitial is the bulk density prior to external forcing, Dp is the depth to which the external forcing impacts ρ, and ∆z is the measured elvation change.

```{r}
# Set parameters
dz = -0.5 # cm
Dp = 5 # cm
rho_i = 0.91 # g/cm^3

# Compute in g/cm^3
delta_rho = rho_i * (Dp / (Dp + dz)) - rho_i

# Print
paste0("Delta rho = ", signif(delta_rho, 3), " g/cm3")

```

## Organic matter additions and losses

$$\Delta SOM = \exp\left(\frac{P_f - 0.9653}{0.1224}\right) - \exp\left(\frac{P_i - 0.9653}{0.1224}\right)$$

$$\Delta P = 1 -\frac{\Delta \rho}{\rho_{s}} $$ Where ∆SOM in the required change in soil organic matter proportion, ∆P is the change in porosity, and ρs is the particle density (g/cm\^3).

```{r}
# Set parameters
dz = -0.5 # cm
Dp = 5 # cm
rho_i = 0.65 # g/cm^3
rho_s = 2.61 # g/cm^3

# Compute initial and final bulk density (g/cm^3)
rho_f = rho_i * (Dp / (Dp + dz))

# Compute initial and final porosity (unit less proportion)
  = 1 - rho_i / rho_s
P_f =  1 - rho_f / rho_s # rho_s would technically change, but the final SOM is relativley insensitive

# Compute change in SOM fraction (cm^3/cm^3)
delta_SOM = exp((P_f - 0.9653)/0.1224) - exp((P_i - 0.9653)/0.1224)

# Print
paste0("Delta SOM = ", signif(delta_SOM, 3), " cm3/cm3")

```

## Root growth and decay

$$\Delta r_l = \frac{\Delta z}{\pi r^2}$$

Where ∆rl is the change in root length (in length per ground area), ∆z is measured elevation change, and r is root radius.

```{r}
# Set parameters
dz = -0.5 # cm
r = 0.1 # cm

# Compute in cm/cm^2
dr = dz / (pi * r^2)

# Convert to mm/cm^2
dr_mm = dr * 10

# Convert to km/m^2
dr_km = dr * (1/100000) * (10000)

# Compute in to g/m^2 assuming root biomass density = 1
dr_g = dz * 1 * 10000

# Print
paste0("Delta r = ", signif(dr, 3), " cm/cm2")
paste0("Delta r = ", signif(dr_mm, 3), " mm/cm2")
paste0("Delta r = ", signif(dr_km, 3), " km/m2")
paste0("Delta r = ", signif(dr_g, 3), " g/m2")

```


## Volumetric strain & Erosion figure

```{r}

# Create Synthetic Data
eros_rate = -0.25 # Set long term erosion rate
time_steps = 1000 # Number of time steps
sim_times = 500 # Number of simulated time periods


dfigure = data.frame(time = seq(1, time_steps, by = 1)) %>% 
  mutate(
    # Volumetric change
    net_volume = 0,
    gross_volume = 3*sin(0.4 * time),
    
    # Erosion
    net_erosion = eros_rate * time,
    gross_erosion = net_erosion + 3*sin(0.15 * time),
    
    # Measured
    total = gross_volume + gross_erosion,
    total_diff = c(0, diff(total))
    
  )

#tibble(dfigure)

plota = ggplot(data = dfigure) +
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = time, y = net_volume), color = "red") +
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = time, y = gross_volume), color = "red") +
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = time, y = net_erosion), color = "blue") +
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = time, y = gross_erosion), color = "blue") +
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = time, y = total), linewidth = 1.3) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "elevation"
  ) +
  labs(
      title = "Conceptual Figure",
      subtitle = paste0("Erosion rate:", eros_rate, " | Time steps:", time_steps, " | Sim. Times: ", sim_times)
  )



# Simulate some "measured" data ranges
time_pairs = replicate(sim_times, sort(sample(time_steps, 2))) 

dtest = data.frame(
  start = time_pairs[1, ],
  end = time_pairs[2, ]
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    dt = end - start
  )



# Pull simulated data values over the simulated data ranges
sets = c("gross_volume", "gross_erosion", "total")
# Loop for each variable of interest
for(j in sets){
  
  dj = dtest
  
  # Loop for each row in the dtest table
  for(i in 1:sim_times){
    
    # Pull j start
    dj[i,"zstart"] = dfigure %>% 
      filter(time == dtest[i, "start"]) %>% 
      dplyr::select(j)
    
    # Pull j end
    dj[i,"zend"] = dfigure %>% 
      filter(time == dtest[i, "end"]) %>% 
      dplyr::select(j)
    
  }
  
  # Return the a new dataset
  dj = dj %>% mutate(
    dz = zend - zstart,
    dzdt = dz / dt,
   
    # Log transform dt and dzdt
    log_dt = log(dt),
    log_dzdt = log(abs(dzdt))

    )
  
  
  
  # Non-log computations
  # Compute intercept
  lm = lm(data = dj, dzdt ~ 1)
  rate = tidy(lm)$estimate

  plotj <- ggplot(data = dj) +
    geom_point(aes(x = dt, y = dzdt)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = eros_rate) +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "rate of elevation change") +
    scale_x_continuous(name = "measurement period") +
    labs(
      title = j,
      subtitle = paste0("Intercept: ", rate)
    )
  
  
  
  
  
  # Log computations
  # Compute intercept and slope
  # Mean (regular lm)
  lm_log = lm(data = dj, log_dzdt ~ log_dt)
  log_coef = tidy(lm_log)$estimate
  
  # Median
  med_log <- rq(data = dj, log_dzdt ~ log_dt, tau = 0.5)
  log_med_coef = coef(med_log)
  
  # Plot
  plotj2 = ggplot(data = dj, mapping = aes(x = log_dt, y = log_dzdt)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE) + # Mean
    geom_quantile(quantiles = 0.5, formula = y ~ x, color = "firebrick") + # Median
    
    geom_hline(yintercept = log(abs(eros_rate))) +
    geom_abline(slope = -1, intercept = log(abs(eros_rate)), linetype = 2) +
    geom_abline(slope = -0.5, intercept = log(abs(eros_rate)), linetype = 3) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(name = "log rate of elevation change") +
    scale_x_continuous(name = "log measurement period") +
        labs(
      title = j,
      subtitle = paste0("Mean - Intercept: ", round(log_coef[[1]], 3), " | Slope: ", round(log_coef[[2]], 4),
                        "\n Median - Intercept: ", round(log_med_coef[[1]], 3), " | Slope: ", round(log_med_coef[[2]], 4))
    )

  
  
  
  # Make global variables
  assign(paste0(j, "_data"), dj)
  assign(paste0(j, "_plot"), plotj)
  assign(paste0(j, "_plot2"), plotj2)
  
  }

# gross_volume_data
# gross_erosion_data
# total_data


# Plot all
signed_rates = plot_grid(total_plot, gross_volume_plot, gross_erosion_plot, cols = 2)
signed_rates2 = plot_grid(total_plot2, gross_volume_plot2, gross_erosion_plot2, cols = 2)

plot_grid(plota, signed_rates2)
# plota
# signed_rates
# signed_rates2


```

Observations:
1. The period/frequency of the cyclical pattern of total elevation change can be seen in simulated data. Elevation data simulated over a time period equal to the period (or to some combination of the periods) has very low variance.
2. The mean elevation change also increases significantly with dt.
